The current test build

Bounty keeps shared-expense records, calculates splits and records settlements. Recording a settlement does not transfer money.

Local and Demo workspaces remain separate. Signing in connects subscription access; it does not automatically upload these ledgers. Cloud sharing, invitations, remote receipts and automatic cloud-account deletion are paused.

These notices remain under review. The legal operator, launch audience and markets, support handling and retention details still need confirmation before final policies and terms can be approved.

For this website’s theme preference, GitHub Pages hosting and email links, see Portfolio privacy and storage. App information is covered by the separate Bounty notices above.
